name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard ChainResponse requires a pickup on the very next step after every fall. The hard Response requires the box to be held when reaching the exit; since at_exit is true only on the final step, it must be held then. Both clauses match the task, and no unconditional goal is missing.

texts: Whenever the box falls, pick it up on the very next step.
If you reach the exit, have the box in your hands.
